executive_summary: The Singaporean government and industry associations are actively promoting sustainability and digitalization in the built environment, with initiatives such as the Construction Startup Competition and the BuildSG LEAD Summit 2026.
Companies like Azbil, Johnson Controls, and Ramboll are advancing sustainability and digitalization in the built environment through new projects and partnerships.
Competitors like G Element and DataMesh are driving innovation in digital twin technology and smart building management, with partnerships and new product launches.
